profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: Currently working as a SWE at Microsoft helping bring new technologies and innovations to the connected experience in Visual Studio

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Innovating and helping maintain a vibrant extensibility ecosystem within Visual Studio. Helped design, implement, and maintain the Visual Studio Integrated Terminal which became a critical component for the shift towards cloud developer codespaces.

positions.title: SWE Intern
positions.description: Designed, implemented, and tested an easy way to import user snippets, preferences, and other data from Textmate and Sublime text into Visual Studio.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: I worked with the engineering department where I designed and coded a program that would control the flow of items from and to the office inventory.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

honors.title: Best iOS App Design
honors.description: Created the winning iOS demo application with a team of 4. Won as the best designed app and was used as a model for the current ITESM Official app

honors.title: Excellence in Programming
honors.description: Achieved an Excellence award by programming PCL computers and NXT robots with NXC

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered as a teaching assistant at the Bellevue Christian High School as we gave students an introduction to computer science using Snap! and other tools.
With the help of Google, I helped educate the Austin lower-income and senior community regarding technologies and how to use them. Such as computers, smartphones, email, and other tools.

projects.title: I.T.E.S.M. App Draft
projects.description: Designed and programmed an iOS app that won 1st place as the one with best design. It was used as the template for the Official I.T.E.S.M. app that is now in the Appstore (Tec 70). I was the project leader and my team programmed and designed the app.

testScores.name: Computer Architecture and  Organization
testScores.description: Finished my CS429 course with an A as my final grade

testScores.name: Data Management
testScores.description: Finished my Data Management class with flying colors even though it has been my first time exposed to SQL and server management.
